items.title: Aluwind Infratech targets Rs 200 crore turnover this fiscal on healthy order book
items.description: The company, which offers aluminium windows and glass facade solutions, registered a 26.76 per cent rise in total revenues for FY2025-26 to Rs 140.10 crore from Rs 110.52 crore in FY 25 despite facing operational headwinds due to volatile commodity prices and geopolitical tensions

items.title: Aayush Wellness forays into diabetes, metabolic health sector
items.description: The company has launched 'Aayush Dia Shield Tablets', a nutraceutical product designed for modern lifestyles, offering a convenient daily format that fosters repeat-consumption behaviour, it said in a statement.
